claim: Three supplemental upstream tools installed natively: Beads persisted task claims and dependency transitions, skills-ref validated and rendered a selected skill, and otel-tui ingested and displayed one synthetic loopback trace.
limitations: Bounded native CLI/TUI acceptance on Linux/WSL; no new native Codex or Claude provider task was run for these additions.
Beads used one owned Git fixture with embedded Dolt, explicit task scope, skipped agent-instruction generation and skipped hooks. It does not replace ai-memory.
skills-ref is upstream's reference/demo implementation; successful portable-format validation does not certify production client extensions or tool semantics.
otel-tui received one synthetic local trace; no production or native-provider telemetry session was evaluated and no persistent exporter was installed.
None of these three tools exposes a verified cumulative token-savings counter. Exact causal lifetime provider savings remain null.
Public command forms substitute portable variables for private host paths; private raw operation logs are not published.
